summary: CRA-to-Vite 5 migration testing (iteration 65). All critical migration checks passed: no blank screen, login works, navigation works, API calls reach backend. The vite.config.js correctly forwards REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via define and handles JSX in .js files via esbuild loader.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vite 5 migration verified: (1) Login page renders correctly — no blank screen, JSX in .js files works. (2) Login with admin@supervision.com / Admin123! succeeds, redirects to /dashboard. (3) Navigation — Organisation (/organisation) and Schedules (/admin/schedules) pages load correctly. (4) process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is correctly resolved — confirmed by successful /api/meetings/ API call returning meeting data. (5) Meeting report page: only 1 meeting exists, it's in Draft state so /review/{id} redirects to dashboard (expected behavior — review page only accessible for processed meetings). Dashboard, Meetings list, Organisation (People Hub), Schedules all load without errors. No console JS errors from Vite build.
rca_of_issues: No issues found. Vite migration is working correctly. The define plugin in vite.config.js correctly replaces process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL at build time. JSX in .js files handled by esbuild loader:jsx config.
